karty.priklad: Mae'r cwrs yn ddwys iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: The course is very intensive (dwys → [dd]wys after yn).
karty.mnemo: DWYS sounds like "DO ICE": on an intensive course you DO ICE baths every morning.

extra.pozn: gofal dwys = intensive care (L10, card 0431); dwyster = intensity; own example

karty.priklad: Gwelais i gath wyllt yn y goedwig.
karty.priklad_cs: I saw a wild cat in the forest (cath → [g]ath as the object; gwyllt → [w]yllt after the feminine cath; coedwig → [g]oedwig after the article y with the feminine coedwig).
karty.mnemo: g-WYLL-t sounds like WILD: a wild cat.

extra.pozn: tân gwyllt = fireworks (p. 172); gwylltio = to get furious; own example; check: in southern speech more likely Weles i

karty.priklad: Mae hyder yn hollbwysig.
karty.priklad_cs: Confidence is all-important.

extra.pozn: the p of pwysig is mutated inside the compound (holl + pwysig → hollbwysig); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r cae'n fwdlyd iawn ar ôl y glaw.
karty.priklad_cs: The pitch is very muddy after the rain (mwdlyd → [f]wdlyd after 'n).

extra.pozn: the ending -lyd/-llyd (compare rhewllyd, L3); in the book trac mwdlyd (p. 173); own example

karty.priklad: Mae swyddi da'n brin yn yr ardal.
karty.priklad_cs: Good jobs are scarce in the area (prin → [b]rin after 'n).

extra.pozn: prin before a verb = hardly, barely (prin dw i'n ei nabod e = I hardly know him); prinder = shortage; own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n nyrs brofiadol iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: She's a very experienced nurse (profiadol → [b]rofiadol after the feminine nyrs).

extra.pozn: profiad = experience (L2); dibrofiad = inexperienced; own example

karty.priklad: Ga i docyn sengl i Gaerdydd, os gwelwch yn dda?
karty.priklad_cs: Can I have a single ticket to Cardiff, please? (tocyn → [d]ocyn after Ga i; Caerdydd → [G]aerdydd after i)

extra.pozn: tocyn sengl = single ticket, tocyn dwyffordd = return; also of a person: Mae e'n sengl = he's single; own example

karty.priklad: Ro'n i'n sychedig iawn ar ôl rhedeg.
karty.priklad_cs: I was very thirsty after running.
karty.mnemo: SYCHED ~ SUCKED dry: your throat is sucked dry.

extra.pozn: colloquially more often Mae syched arna i = I'm thirsty; sych = dry; own example

karty.priklad: Mae popeth drosodd.
karty.priklad_cs: Everything's over.

extra.pozn: the base form trosodd is hardly used in speech, the coursebook gives drosodd; gweler drosodd = see overleaf; sentence from the listening on p. 180

karty.cs: to make a mess of, to botch
karty.priklad: Mae Carol wedi gwneud cawl o drefniadau'r parti Nadolig.
karty.priklad_cs: Carol has made a mess of the Christmas party arrangements (trefniadau → [d]refniadau after o).
karty.mnemo: To make soup (cawl) of it: a right old mess.

extra.pozn: the mutation is caused by the final o; sentence from the listening on p. 180

karty.priklad: Dw i'n teimlo fel clywed tipyn o fân siarad gyda Robin.
karty.priklad_cs: I feel like hearing a bit of chit-chat with Robin (mân → [f]ân after o).
karty.mnemo: mân (tiny, small) + siarad (to talk): little bits of talk.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; masculine like siarad (the coursebook gives no gender); mân = small, tiny (L2); sentence from the dialogue Tagfa, p. 182

sever.priklad: Dw i'n teimlo fel clywed tipyn o fân siarad efo Robin.
sever.priklad_cs: I feel like hearing a bit of chit-chat with Robin (mân → [f]ân after o).

karty.priklad: Wyt ti o ddifri?
karty.priklad_cs: Are you serious?
karty.mnemo: Short for o ddifrif – the same root as difrifol (serious).

extra.pozn: difrifol = serious (L10); also spelt o ddifrif; own example

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n gwybod pob dim am bawb.
karty.priklad_cs: She knows everything about everybody (pawb → [b]awb after am).

extra.pozn: = popeth (synonym from the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Mae fy chwaer i wedi bod yn rhiant maeth ers deg mlynedd.
karty.priklad_cs: My sister has been a foster parent for ten years (blynedd → [m]lynedd after deg).
karty.mnemo: rhiant (parent) + maeth (nourishment): the parent who feeds and raises you.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; masculine like rhiant (even for a woman); plural rhieni maeth (Robin Radio, p. 185); maethu = to foster; own example

karty.priklad: Enillodd hi'r ras draws gwlad.
karty.priklad_cs: She won the cross-country race (traws → [d]raws after the feminine ras).

extra.pozn: rhedwr traws gwlad = cross-country runner (p. 173); own example

karty.priklad: Rwyt ti'n gwybod bod Sara ychydig yn drwm ei chlyw.
karty.priklad_cs: You know Sara is a bit hard of hearing (trwm → [d]rwm after yn; clyw → [ch]lyw after ei = her).

extra.pozn: the form changes with the person: trwm ei glyw (he), trwm ei chlyw (she), trwm fy nghlyw (I); sentence from the listening on p. 180

karty.priklad: Ro'n i wedi blino'n lân, felly cwympais i i gysgu ar y soffa.
karty.priklad_cs: I was exhausted, so I fell asleep on the sofa (glân → [l]ân after 'n; cysgu → [g]ysgu after i).
karty.mnemo: Tired "clean" out (glân): nothing left at all.

extra.pozn: glân = clean; cwympo i gysgu = to fall asleep; own example

sever.priklad: Ro'n i wedi blino'n lân, felly syrthiais i i gysgu ar y soffa.
sever.priklad_cs: I was exhausted, so I fell asleep on the sofa (glân → [l]ân after 'n; cysgu → [g]ysgu after i).

karty.priklad: Roedden nhw'n magu ceffylau'n bennaf.
karty.priklad_cs: They mainly bred horses.

extra.pozn: pennaf = chief, foremost; sentence based on the book extract on p. 185

karty.cs: alive and kicking, safe and sound
karty.priklad: Mae'r hen gath yn fyw ac yn iach!
karty.priklad_cs: The old cat is alive and kicking! (byw → [f]yw after yn; cath → [g]ath after hen)

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Dw i'n gallu cynnal sgwrs yn Gymraeg nawr.
karty.priklad_cs: I can hold a conversation in Welsh now (Cymraeg → [G]ymraeg after yn).

extra.pozn: cynnal = to hold (an event) (L5); Robin Radio, p. 185; own example

sever.priklad: Dw i'n medru cynnal sgwrs yn Gymraeg rŵan.
sever.priklad_cs: I can hold a conversation in Welsh now (Cymraeg → [G]ymraeg after yn).
sever.pozn: north: medru instead of gallu (L7), rŵan instead of nawr (L12)
